title: Opportunistic Risk Assessment of Major Osteoporotic Fractures from Routine Chest Radiographs Using Deep Learning
zh_title: 基于常规胸片深度学习的机会性骨质疏松性骨折风险评估
summary: 在5.3万成人中训练CNN生存模型，并在两家独立机构8.5万患者中外部验证，利用常规胸片预测主要骨质疏松性骨折。
key_points: 训练队列53,109人，外部验证85,284人
对象均为已行DXA检查者
主要结局为主要骨质疏松性骨折的发生
reason: 大样本且多机构外部验证，属重要档；无前瞻性结局
abstract: Background Bone mineral density (BMD) and the Fracture Risk Assessment Tool (FRAX) incompletely capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where much of the fracture burden occurs. Routine chest radiographs are acquired across a broad range of patients and may contain information relevant to fracture risk, offering a potential opportunistic complement without additional imaging burden. Methods We developed a convolutional neural network survival model in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated it in 85,284 patients from two independent institutions. Eligibility required a chest radiograph obtained within 1 year of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry scans, so all participants had been referred for densitometry. The primary outcome was incident major osteoporotic fracture. Discrimination was assessed by using the concordance index (C-index) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years, compared with FRAX with BMD and with the lowest BMD T-score. Results In the external validation cohorts (mean 58.6 years of age; 68.9% female; and follow-up of 77 months), the deep-learning (DL) model achieved a C-index of 0.843 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.837 to 0.850) and a censoring-adjusted 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.846 to 0.863), which was higher than that of FRAX with BMD (C-index, 0.779, 95% CI, 0.770 to 0.787; 10-year AUROC, 0.785, 95% CI, 0.775 to 0.794; both P Conclusions A survival DL model applied to routine chest radiographs identified patients at high fracture risk with discrimination exceeding that of FRAX, with the greatest benefit in patients with osteopenia. As all participants had been referred for densitometry, absolute-risk and case-finding estimates require prospective evaluation in an unselected routine-radiography population. (Funded by the National Research Foundation of Korea and others.).
zh_abstract:
【背景】骨密度（BMD）和骨折风险评估工具（FRAX）不能完全反映骨量减少范围内的骨折风险，而大部分骨折负担正出现在这一范围。常规胸部X线片在广泛的患者中获取，可能包含与骨折风险相关的信息，有望在不增加额外影像负担的情况下作为一种机会性补充手段。
【方法】我们在一家三级医院的53,109名成人中开发了一种卷积神经网络生存模型，并在来自两家独立机构的85,284名患者中进行了外部验证。纳入要求为在双能X线吸收测定扫描后1年内有胸部X线片，因此所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定。主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折。使用一致性指数（C-index）以及2年、3年、5年和10年的受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估区分度，并与结合BMD的FRAX以及最低BMD T值进行比较。
【结果】在外部验证队列中（平均年龄58.6岁；女性占68.9%；随访77个月），深度学习（DL）模型的C-index为0.843（95%置信区间[CI]，0.837至0.850），经删失校正的10年AUROC为0.855（95% CI，0.846至0.863），高于结合BMD的FRAX（C-index，0.779，95% CI，0.770至0.787；10年AUROC，0.785，95% CI，0.775至0.794；两者P值……）。
【结论】应用于常规胸部X线片的生存DL模型识别高骨折风险患者的区分度超过FRAX，在骨量减少患者中获益最大。由于所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定，绝对风险和病例发现的估计需要在未经选择的常规X线摄影人群中进行前瞻性评估。（由韩国国家研究基金会等资助。）

title: Routine laboratory trajectories predict organ-level complications in cancer
zh_title: 常规实验室指标轨迹预测癌症器官级并发症
summary: Transformer 利用 3905 例多发性骨髓瘤/卵巢癌患者的纵向常规化验数据，预测两年内新发的 162 种治疗相关并发症。
key_points: 277 万余项化验值，预测 162 种并发症、覆盖八类临床类别
各终点 AUROC 较非序列基线高 0.024–0.070
在 MIMIC-IV 和 MMRF CoMMpass 上做了外部验证
reason: 有外部验证，但人群仅两种癌症；摘要被截断，未见临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Routine laboratory panels drawn during cancer treatment constitute longitudinal physiological recordings of organ function, yet their temporal structure is discarded by single-timepoint prognostic tools. A transformer trained on 2,777,595 laboratory measurements from 3905 patients with multiple myeloma or ovarian cancer predicted which of 162 treatment-associated complications would be newly recorded within two years, spanning eight clinical categories, achieving 1.5- to 6.1-fold enrichment above prevalence. Across individual endpoints it exceeded non-sequential baselines, including engineered-trajectory models, by +0.024 to +0.070 in mean AUROC. Predictions generalised across both cancers, divergence concentrating in disease-specific complications, and biomarker masking recovered signatures consistent with established pathophysiology. External validation on MIMIC-IV and MMRF CoMMpass showed transferability, strongest for renal and metabolic endpoints, attenuated for infection endpoints. On CoMMpass it added prognostic value to ISS staging. Routine oncological laboratory data carry complication-specific physiological signal months before a complication is recorded, and require no testing beyond standard oncological care.

title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient–Physician Communication — The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
zh_title: 就诊前AI生成文档摘要对问诊时间与医患沟通的影响：AI-INFOCARE随机对照试验
summary: 单中心神经外科门诊随机试验，300人按1:1分组，评估就诊前经质检的AI通俗摘要是否改善患者报告的医患互动质量。
key_points: 300名成人1:1随机分配
主要终点为FAPI医患互动质量
次要终点含自主支持、就诊难度和问诊时长
reason: 随机对照设计、有工作流和沟通结局，但单中心样本较小
abstract: Background Limited health literacy, clinical jargon, and time-constrained consultations often impair patients' understanding of medical findings. We evaluated whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay language summaries provided before consultations improve communication-related outcomes. Methods In this single-center, randomized trial in an outpatient neurosurgical setting, 300 adults were randomly assigned 1:1 to standard care with or without a quality-checked, AI-generated layperson summary of their medical findings (Simply Onno) before consultation. The primary end point was patient-reported quality of physician-patient interaction (Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]). Secondary end points included autonomy support (Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]), encounter difficulty (Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]), and consultation duration (minutes). Results The mean FAPI score was higher in the intervention group (4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54; difference, 0.17; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.05 to 0.29; P=0.005; Hedges' g=0.33), driven by shared decision-making (difference, 0.29; 95% CI, 0.15 to 0.42), with no evidence of a difference in perceived empathy. Patient-rated autonomy support was higher (difference, 0.14; 95% CI, 0.06 to 0.23), whereas physicians rated their own autonomy support slightly lower (difference, -0.12; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.21 to -0.04). Median consultation time was 25 versus 33 minutes in the intervention group versus the control group, respectively, an approximate 21% relative reduction (ratio of geometric means, 0.79; 95% CI, 0.70 to 0.88). For encounter difficulty (DDPRQ-10), we found potential evidence of a small increase (difference, 0.09; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.03 to 0.21). Secondary end point confidence intervals were unadjusted for multiplicity. Conclusions AI-generated summaries provided before outpatient neurosurgical consultations were associated with better patient-reported interaction quality and autonomy support and shorter consultations. Physicians rated their own autonomy support as slightly lower in the intervention group; evidence for increased encounter difficulty was limited, with confidence intervals compatible with no difference. These findings support further evaluation of quality-checked, patient-facing document translation; effects on clinical outcomes and clinician workload require confirmation before routine adoption.
zh_abstract:
【背景】健康素养有限、临床术语以及时间受限的诊疗常常妨碍患者对医学检查结果的理解。我们评估了在诊疗前提供经质量核查的、由人工智能（AI）生成的通俗语言摘要是否能改善与沟通相关的结局。
【方法】在这项于门诊神经外科环境中开展的单中心随机试验中，300名成人按1:1随机分配至标准诊疗组，或在诊疗前额外获得一份经质量核查的、由AI生成的关于其医学检查结果的通俗摘要（Simply Onno）的标准诊疗组。主要终点为患者报告的医患互动质量（Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]）。次要终点包括自主性支持（Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]）、诊疗接触困难程度（Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]）以及诊疗时长（分钟）。
【结果】干预组的FAPI平均得分更高（4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54；差值0.17；95%置信区间[CI]，0.05至0.29；P=0.005；Hedges' g=0.33），这主要由共同决策驱动（差值0.29；95% CI，0.15至0.42），而在感知到的共情方面未发现存在差异的证据。患者评定的自主性支持更高（差值0.14；95% CI，0.06至0.23），而医生对自身自主性支持的评分略低（差值-0.12；聚类稳健95% CI，-0.21至-0.04）。干预组与对照组的诊疗时间中位数分别为25分钟和33分钟，相对减少约21%（几何均数之比0.79；95% CI，0.70至0.88）。对于诊疗接触困难程度（DDPRQ-10），我们发现可能存在小幅升高的证据（差值0.09；聚类稳健95% CI，-0.03至0.21）。次要终点的置信区间未针对多重比较进行校正。
【结论】在门诊神经外科诊疗前提供AI生成的摘要，与患者报告的互动质量和自主性支持改善以及诊疗时间缩短相关。干预组中医生对自身自主性支持的评分略低；诊疗接触困难程度增加的证据有限，其置信区间与无差异相容。这些发现支持对经质量核查、面向患者的文档转译开展进一步评估；其对临床结局和临床医生工作量的影响需在常规应用前得到证实。

title: Artificial Intelligence–Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction — Development and External Validation in Prospective Multicenter Studies
zh_title: AI增强听诊识别左心室功能障碍：前瞻性多中心开发与外部验证
summary: 前瞻性多中心研究，用数字听诊结合单导联心电，以Transformer与1D-CNN集成模型检测超声所定义的左心室功能障碍(LVEF≤40%)。
key_points: 转诊行超声心动图的成人前瞻性入组
四个标准听诊部位同步单导联心电
集成Transformer与1D-CNN，含外部验证
reason: 前瞻性多中心并有外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Background Left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) is common and associated with adverse prognosis, even in asymptomatic individuals. Early treatment improves outcomes, underscoring the need for efficient strategies to identify patients who may benefit from echocardiographic evaluation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an AI auscultation method to detect LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography. Methods In this prospective, multicenter study, adult patients referred for echocardiography were enrolled to undergo digital auscultation at four standard auscultation sites with simultaneous single-lead ECGs. LVD was defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than or equal to 40% on concurrent echocardiography. An ensemble model combining a transformer-based network and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was trained on multicenter data and externally validated. The model's performance was compared with a seven-cardiologist reader substudy and clinical logistic regression models incorporating clinical variables, single-lead ECG-derived features, and B-type natriuretic peptide levels. Results The multicenter training cohort included 2359 patients (mean age, 69.7±13.5 years; 40.4% female; 8.9% with reduced LVEF). The external validation cohort of 964 patients (mean age, 68.6±15.4 years; 38.9% female; 7.6% with reduced LVEF) was obtained from another independent multicenter registry. The four-site AI auscultation outperformed ECG-only models and the clinical logistic models, achieving an area under the receiver operator curve (AUROC) of 0.926 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.911 to 0.939) in the training cohort. In the external validation cohort, AUROC was 0.904 (95% CI, 0.876 to 0.930) and sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were 86.3%, 74.2%, and 75.1%, respectively. In a 100-patient reader substudy, AI auscultation outperformed cardiologist consensus in accuracy (82.0% vs. 62.0%; P=0.004). Model performance was consistent across prespecified subgroups. The simplified two-site auscultation model retained high accuracy in the external validation cohort (AUROC, 0.903; 95% CI, 0.878 to 0.927). Conclusions AI auscultation accurately detected LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography, supporting its potential as a scalable and accessible pre-echocardiographic risk-enrichment tool. Further validation is warranted before broader screening applications. (Funded by AMI Inc

【背景】左心室功能障碍（LVD）很常见，即使在无症状个体中也与不良预后相关。早期治疗可改善结局，这凸显了需要高效策略来识别可能从超声心动图评估中获益的患者。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一种AI听诊方法，用于在因临床指征转诊行超声心动图检查的患者中检测LVD。
【方法】在这项前瞻性多中心研究中，纳入因超声心动图转诊的成年患者，在四个标准听诊部位进行数字听诊，并同步记录单导联心电图。LVD定义为同期超声心动图显示左心室射血分数（LVEF）小于或等于40%。采用结合基于Transformer的网络与一维卷积神经网络的集成模型，在多中心数据上训练并进行外部验证。将该模型的性能与由七名心脏病专家参与的读片者子研究以及纳入临床变量、单导联心电图衍生特征和B型利钠肽水平的临床逻辑回归模型进行比较。
【结果】多中心训练队列包括2359名患者（平均年龄69.7±13.5岁；40.4%为女性；8.9%LVEF降低）。外部验证队列包含964名患者（平均年龄68.6±15.4岁；38.9%为女性；7.6%LVEF降低），来自另一个独立的多中心登记研究。四部位AI听诊优于仅用心电图的模型和临床逻辑模型，在训练队列中受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.926（95%置信区间[CI]，0.911至0.939）。在外部验证队列中，AUROC为0.904（95% CI，0.876至0.930），敏感性、特异性和准确率分别为86.3%、74.2%和75.1%。在一项100例患者的读片者子研究中，AI听诊在准确率上优于心脏病专家共识（82.0% vs. 62.0%；P=0.004）。模型性能在预先设定的各亚组中保持一致。简化的两部位听诊模型在外部验证队列中保持了较高的准确性（AUROC，0.903；95% CI，0.878至0.927）。

title: FIRE-EVIDENCE: enabling LLM-driven, machine-readable evidence synthesis for women’s health
zh_title: FIRE-EVIDENCE：面向女性健康的LLM机器可读证据合成
summary: 提出基于大语言模型的框架，将临床研究全文转化为符合FHIR的结构化可计算证据，并在两个数据集上评估，聚焦女性健康与更年期。
key_points: 将全文临床研究转为FHIR对齐的结构化证据
在7篇开发文档上优化流程
在26项RCT和18项系统综述来源研究上评估
reason: 新颖LLM证据合成方法，评估样本小，无外部临床验证
abstract: Clinical evidence is abundant in the published literature yet remains fragmented and underutilized, particularly in women’s health and menopause, where timely, personalized decision-making is critical. Conventional evidence synthesis relies on resource-intensive manual review, limiting scalability and delaying translation into practice, while automated approaches often produce outputs that are not directly computable or integrable into decision-support workflows. We present FIRE-EVIDENCE, a large language model framework that transforms full-text clinical studies into structured, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)-aligned computable evidence. The pipeline was optimized on seven development documents and evaluated on two datasets: a primary dataset of 26 expert-annotated randomized controlled trials and a secondary dataset of 18 studies derived from five systematic reviews. Across expert-annotated trials, FIRE-EVIDENCE achieved 94.35% completeness, 94.61% correctness, 97.36% source faithfulness, and an F1 score of 94.43%. FHIR-compliance testing in a 10-output native FHIR-R5 subset showed that all validated outputs passed base HL7 FHIR validation without errors. FIRE-EVIDENCE demonstrates a feasible pathway for standard-based, machine-readable evidence synthesis.
zh_abstract: 已发表文献中临床证据丰富，但仍然碎片化且未得到充分利用，在女性健康和更年期领域尤为如此，而这些领域恰恰需要及时、个体化的决策。传统的证据综合依赖耗费大量资源的人工审阅，限制了可扩展性并延缓了向临床实践的转化；而自动化方法生成的输出往往不可直接计算，也难以整合进决策支持工作流程。我们提出了 FIRE-EVIDENCE，这是一个大语言模型框架，可将临床研究全文转化为与快速医疗互操作性资源（Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources，FHIR）对齐的结构化、可计算证据。该流程在七份开发文档上进行了优化，并在两个数据集上进行了评估：一个主数据集，包含 26 项经专家标注的随机对照试验；一个次级数据集，包含源自五项系统综述的 18 项研究。在经专家标注的试验中，FIRE-EVIDENCE 的完整性为 94.35%，正确性为 94.61%，来源忠实度为 97.36%，F1 分数为 94.43%。在包含 10 个原生 FHIR-R5 输出的子集中进行的 FHIR 合规性测试显示，所有经验证的输出均无错误地通过了基础 HL7 FHIR 验证。FIRE-EVIDENCE 展示了一条基于标准、机器可读的证据综合的可行路径。

title: A Meta-Research Review of Statistical Practices for Image-Reliant AI Tools Predicting Lung Cancer Outcomes
zh_title: 肺癌影像AI预测工具统计实践的元研究综述
summary: 对36项2023至2025年基于影像的肺癌AI研究进行横断面元研究，评估其方法学严谨性与报告透明度，发现不确定性量化等存在不足。
key_points: 纳入36项研究，75%使用CNN
81%以AUC为主要指标
64%报告不确定性，多限于整体指标置信区间
reason: 元研究综述，有方法学价值，综述类上限6分
abstract: AbstractAI models using medical images are increasingly proposed to support clinical decision-making in lung cancer, motivating assessment of their methodological rigor and transparency. To assess how these models are developed, evaluated, and reported, and to identify gaps in best statistical practices, we conducted a cross-sectional meta-research review of OpenAlex-indexed studies (January 1, 2023, to June 30, 2025) that developed image-based AI tools for lung cancer risk prediction, detection, or prognosis. Thirty-six studies met our inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks were used in most studies (27 studies, 75%), and area under the curve (AUC) was the most frequently reported evaluation metric (29 studies, 81%). Although 23 studies (64%) reported some form of uncertainty quantification, most were limited to presenting confidence intervals for global performance metrics (e.g., AUC, sensitivity, and accuracy) rather than individual prediction- or risk-level uncertainty. Common limitations included limited external test set use (14 studies, 39%), insufficient subgroup analyses (10 studies, 28%), and limited adherence to established prediction-model reporting guidelines. Overall, future research should prioritize standardized reporting, use of external test sets, and model performance assessment across clinically relevant subpopulations. The coexistence of increasingly powerful AI-based prediction models with inconsistent study design, evaluation, and reporting practices emphasizes the urgent need to implement more rigorous and transparent methodological standards in this field. (Funded by Yale School of Public Health.).
zh_abstract: 摘要：基于医学影像的AI模型被越来越多地提出用于支持肺癌的临床决策，这促使人们对其方法学的严谨性和透明度进行评估。为评估这些模型的开发、评价和报告方式，并找出最佳统计实践中的不足，我们对OpenAlex收录的研究（2023年1月1日至2025年6月30日）进行了横断面元研究综述，这些研究开发了用于肺癌风险预测、检测或预后的基于影像的AI工具。共有36项研究符合纳入标准。大多数研究使用了卷积神经网络（27项研究，75%），曲线下面积（AUC）是最常报告的评价指标（29项研究，81%）。尽管23项研究（64%）报告了某种形式的不确定性量化，但大多仅限于给出整体性能指标（如AUC、敏感度和准确度）的置信区间，而非个体预测或风险水平的不确定性。常见的局限包括外部测试集使用有限（14项研究，39%）、亚组分析不足（10项研究，28%），以及对既定预测模型报告指南的遵循有限。总体而言，未来研究应优先考虑标准化报告、使用外部测试集，以及在具有临床意义的亚人群中评估模型性能。日益强大的基于AI的预测模型与不一致的研究设计、评价和报告实践并存，凸显了在该领域实施更严格、更透明的方法学标准的迫切需要。（由耶鲁大学公共卫生学院资助。）

title: Comparative Cost of Care Recommended by Large Language Models versus Treating Physicians
zh_title: 大模型与接诊医生所推荐诊疗的成本比较
summary: 评估24个AI系统在200份门诊/急诊病历上的推荐方案，并按2026年Medicare价格与医生记录方案比较检查和转诊成本。
key_points: 24个AI系统，200份MTSamples脱敏病历
三个LLM提取医嘱并按Medicare定价
还测试了成本意识提示和节俭但安全提示
reason: 系统比较大量模型，但为回顾性公开病历，无结局
abstract: Background Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted for clinical decision support, yet the cost of services or treatment they recommend has not been systematically evaluated. Methods We evaluated 24 AI systems on 200 deidentified outpatient and emergency department notes from MTSamples, a public collection of deidentified U.S.-format clinical notes contributed by practicing clinicians. Each system received the presentation recorded before the physician's assessment and wrote its own plan; the physician's documented plan was the comparator. Orders from both were extracted by three independent LLMs and priced at 2026 Medicare rates. The primary outcome was the per-visit total cost of recommended care: diagnostic tests plus specialist referrals. New medications were counted rather than priced. We also tested two prompts: one cost-aware prompt and one parsimonious-but-safe prompt. Results Across the 20 general-purpose systems, AI-suggested care cost a mean of US$314 per visit, compared with US$97 for care recommended by treating physicians - a difference of US$216 per visit (95% confidence interval, US$177 to US$257; P Conclusions The care these systems recommended cost substantially more than physicians' documented care, chiefly because they suggested testing at visits where the physician had ordered none. LLM outputs are suggestions, not plans of care; final decisions should remain with clinicians.
zh_abstract:
【背景】大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于临床决策支持，但其推荐的服务或治疗的成本尚未得到系统评估。
【方法】我们在MTSamples的200份去标识化门诊和急诊科病历上评估了24个AI系统，MTSamples是由执业临床医生提供的、公开的美国格式去标识化临床病历集合。每个系统获得医生评估之前记录的就诊情况，并自行撰写计划；医生记录的计划作为对照。两者的医嘱由三个独立的LLM提取，并按2026年医疗保险（Medicare）费率定价。主要结局为推荐诊疗的每次就诊总费用：诊断检查加专科转诊。新增药物仅计数、不定价。我们还测试了两种提示语：一种为成本意识提示语，另一种为简约但安全的提示语。
【结果】在20个通用系统中，AI建议的诊疗平均每次就诊费用为314美元，而主治医生推荐的诊疗为97美元，每次就诊相差216美元（95%置信区间，177美元至257美元；P值……）。
【结论】这些系统推荐的诊疗费用明显高于医生记录的诊疗，主要是因为它们在医生未开具任何检查的就诊中建议了检查。LLM的输出是建议，而非诊疗计划；最终决定应由临床医生做出。

title: A Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Pathology Foundation Model for Molecular Decoding of H&E Images
zh_title: Loki2：可生物学解释的单细胞病理基础模型，用于H&E分子解码
summary: 提出单细胞分辨率病理基础模型 Loki2，基于含1500万细胞的 UniSeg 资源训练，探讨常规 H&E 中可恢复的分子与细胞信息。
key_points: UniSeg整合1500万细胞，含分割、谱系注释及转录组谱
在细胞表征、分子可恢复性和患者层面相关性上评估
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 大规模单细胞病理基础模型，命中偏好；预印本，细节有限
abstract: The microscopic structure of human tissues encodes molecular information that is not directly accessible by visual inspection. Current pathology foundation models improve histological interpretation but operate at multicellular resolution. It remains unclear whether routine histology contains structured molecular and cellular information recoverable at single-cell resolution, which biological properties are associated with this recoverability, and where its limits lie. Here, we introduce Loki2, a single-cell pathology foundation model trained on UniSeg, a pan-tissue resource integrating 15 million cells with segmentation, lineage annotations and measured or histology-inferred transcriptomic profiles. We examine the above question across cellular representation, molecular recoverability, and patient-level relevance. Loki2 captures cellular identity and continuous morphological variation, with interpretable latent dimensions linked to physical nuclear phenotypes through DAPI validation. Transcriptomic retrieval and in silico protein staining test molecular recoverability, with gene-level analyses revealing the strongest recovery for genes associated with morphologically distinct cellular identities and functions. Then, patient staging and biomarker discovery connect cellular morphology representations to clinical relevance. Together, these findings establish Loki2 as a biologically interpretable single-cell pathology foundation model and provide the opportunities of recovering cellular and molecular information from routine H&E histology at single-cell resolution.
zh_abstract: 人体组织的微观结构编码了无法通过肉眼观察直接获得的分子信息。目前的病理基础模型改善了组织学解读，但只在多细胞分辨率下运行。目前尚不清楚常规组织学是否包含可在单细胞分辨率下恢复的结构化分子与细胞信息，哪些生物学特性与这种可恢复性相关，以及其局限何在。在此，我们提出 Loki2，一种单细胞病理基础模型，其训练基于 UniSeg——一个整合了1500万个细胞的泛组织资源，包含细胞分割、谱系注释，以及实测或由组织学推断的转录组谱。我们从细胞表征、分子可恢复性和患者层面相关性三个方面探讨上述问题。Loki2 能够捕捉细胞身份和连续的形态学变化，其可解释的潜在维度通过 DAPI 验证与物理性的细胞核表型相关联。转录组检索和计算机模拟蛋白染色用于检验分子可恢复性；基因水平分析显示，与形态学上差异明显的细胞身份和功能相关的基因恢复效果最强。随后，患者分期和生物标志物发现将细胞形态学表征与临床相关性联系起来。总之，这些发现确立了 Loki2 作为一种具有生物学可解释性的单细胞病理基础模型，并为在单细胞分辨率下从常规 H&E 组织学中恢复细胞和分子信息提供了机会。

title: Beyond scales: Artificial intelligence, language, and behavior in suicide risk modeling-a narrative review.
source: PubMed · European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology
zh_title: 超越量表：自杀风险建模中的AI、语言与行为（叙述性综述）
summary: 叙述性综述，总结机器学习、深度学习和LLM基于电子病历、自然语言等多模态数据预测自杀想法与行为的进展。

涵盖自然语言处理等多种模态

reason: 精神健康方向叙述性综述，综述上限6分
abstract: [European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology] Suicide is a leading, preventable cause of premature mortality, yet identifying individuals at imminent risk remains difficult. There are no validated biomarkers for routine stratification, and common approaches (clinical interviews, rating scales, self-report) are limited by subjectivity, reporting bias, and weak positive predictive value for rare outcomes. Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI)-including machine learning, deep learning, and large language models-offer opportunities to integrate heterogeneous signals relevant to risk and treatment response. This narrative review summarizes recent AI-enabled prediction and characterization of suicidal thoughts and behaviors across major data modalities: structured electronic health records and claims; natural language processing of clinical notes and digital text; speech and facial/behavioral signals; neuroimaging and other neurobiological measures; and passive sensing from smartphones and wearables. We review common modeling and evaluation practices, emphasizing clinically relevant performance assessment (discrimination and calibration) and the importance of temporal and external validation. We also highlight barriers to translation, including class imbalance and label noise, dataset shift across sites and time, limited prospective evaluation, and the need for interpretable outputs that can support medication decisions and care pathways (e.g., triage, monitoring, and stepped interventions). Ethical and implementation challenges-privacy and consent, algorithmic bias and equity, governance, and the clinical consequences of false-positive and false-negative predictions-are discussed with an emphasis on safe deployment. We conclude with priorities for the field, including multimodal longitudinal cohorts, harmonized reporting standards, and pragmatic trials to determine whether AI decision support measurably improves suicide-prevention outcomes.
zh_abstract: [欧洲神经精神药理学：欧洲神经精神药理学学院杂志] 自杀是导致过早死亡的主要且可预防的原因，但识别面临迫在眉睫风险的个体仍然困难。目前尚无可用于常规分层的经验证生物标志物，而常用方法（临床访谈、评定量表、自我报告）受限于主观性、报告偏倚，以及对罕见结局的阳性预测值较弱。人工智能（AI）——包括机器学习、深度学习和大语言模型——的快速进展，为整合与风险和治疗反应相关的异质性信号提供了机会。本叙述性综述总结了近期 AI 在多种主要数据模态中对自杀想法和行为进行预测与刻画的进展：结构化电子健康记录和医保理赔数据；对临床笔记和数字文本的自然语言处理；语音及面部/行为信号；神经影像和其他神经生物学测量；以及来自智能手机和可穿戴设备的被动感知。我们回顾了常见的建模与评估实践，强调与临床相关的性能评估（区分度和校准度）以及时间验证和外部验证的重要性。我们还指出了转化应用中的障碍，包括类别不平衡和标签噪声、跨站点和跨时间的数据集偏移、前瞻性评估有限，以及需要可解释的输出以支持用药决策和照护路径（如分诊、监测和阶梯式干预）。文中还讨论了伦理和实施方面的挑战——隐私与知情同意、算法偏倚与公平性、治理，以及假阳性和假阴性预测的临床后果——并强调安全部署。最后，我们提出了该领域的优先事项，包括多模态纵向队列、统一的报告标准，以及用于确定 AI 决策支持能否切实改善自杀预防结局的实用性试验。

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
zh_title: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗的AI基准
summary: 提出开放评测倡议InclusionMed，按三类医疗角色与三种AI能力组织基准，并评测前沿大模型，总指数得分17.5至49.1。
key_points: 从388个候选中筛选4个公开基准
含私有诊断推理基准DxFiles
前沿LLM总分介于17.5–49.1
reason: 新基准框架，预印本，部分基准私有
abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
zh_abstract: 推进面向包容性医疗的医学 AI，需要在多样的医疗角色、任务和照护场景中进行评估，但基准的覆盖仍不均衡。我们提出 InclusionMed，这是一项面向包容性医疗的开放医学 AI 评估倡议。InclusionMed Atlas 围绕三种医疗角色和三种 AI 能力来组织各项基准。在首次发布中，我们通过结构化审核和独立复现，从 388 个候选基准中选出四个公开基准。加上我们的私有诊断推理基准 InclusionMed-DxFiles，Atlas 包含五个基准，覆盖其九个角色-能力单元中的三个。我们在 Atlas 上评估了前沿大语言模型，并将结果汇总为 InclusionMed 指数，总体得分范围为 17.5 至 49.1（满分 100）。该指数还按医疗角色和 AI 能力分别报告得分，显示模型的排名随所考虑的角色或能力而变化。使用任务级标签进行的基准内分析表明，指数中排名前十的模型在患者沟通上的得分均高于临床决策。指数得分相近的模型在估计的推理成本上也存在显著差异。这些发现凸显了需要开展覆盖更多样医疗需求的评估，以及针对具体情境进行模型选择。通过开放协作和社区贡献，InclusionMed 力求确保全球多样的医疗需求能够影响医学 AI 进展的定义和衡量方式。

title: Towards wearable-scale, transition-aware sleep staging for clinical populations
zh_title: 面向临床人群的可穿戴级、感知转换的睡眠分期
summary: 提出以 SleepGPT 为教师、超轻量 CNN-GRU 为学生的蒸馏框架，并引入 Gcv-TAD 损失，用于脑卒中、RBD 等临床人群睡眠分期。
key_points: 三个临床队列中觉醒更多、N1 更多、REM 更少
SleepGPT 仅用 25% 患者标签适配
学生模型仅 31k 参数，可实时分期
reason: 睡眠基础模型蒸馏，有新方法，预印本且证据有限
abstract: Automatic sleep staging models are predominantly developed on healthy sleepers and generalize poorly to clinical populations with fragmented sleep. Across three cohorts (patients with stroke, isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder, and other sleep disorders), we observe 2-3x more awakenings per hour, nearly twice as much N1, and less REM sleep than in healthy sleepers. We propose a label-efficient teacher-student framework for wearable-scale sleep staging. SleepGPT (136M parameters), adapted using labels from 25% of training patients, supervises a causal CNN-GRU (31k parameters; 122 KB) that stages EEG, EOG, or both in real time. We introduce Gcv-TAD, a new black-box transition-aware distillation loss. It emphasizes uncommon stage transitions while discounting those that vary across patients, using a prior estimated from labelled patients. In patient-wise 10-fold cross-validation, Gcv-TAD improves per-patient macro F1 over supervised training on the same labels by +3.2 to +7.6 points on average. Gains are largest on N1, and performance approaches full-label training.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期模型主要基于健康睡眠者开发，在睡眠碎片化的临床人群中泛化能力较差。在三个队列（卒中患者、孤立性快速眼动睡眠行为障碍患者和其他睡眠障碍患者）中，我们观察到每小时觉醒次数是健康睡眠者的2-3倍，N1期接近其两倍，而快速眼动（REM）睡眠较少。我们提出一种面向可穿戴设备规模的、标签高效的教师-学生框架。SleepGPT（1.36亿参数）利用25%训练患者的标签进行适配，并监督一个因果CNN-GRU（3.1万参数；122 KB），后者可对EEG、EOG或二者联合进行实时分期。我们提出了Gcv-TAD，一种新的黑盒式、感知转换的蒸馏损失。它利用从有标签患者估计的先验，强调少见的睡眠分期转换，同时降低在患者之间变化较大的转换的权重。在按患者划分的10折交叉验证中，与使用相同标签的监督训练相比，Gcv-TAD使每位患者的宏平均F1平均提高了+3.2至+7.6个百分点。N1期的提升最大，性能接近使用全部标签训练的水平。

title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
zh_title: EEGProbe：视觉语言模型真的理解脑电吗？
summary: 提出含620道题、13个子任务的信号基础EEG基准，评估通用视觉语言模型对原始通道脑电的提取与推理能力。
key_points: 涵盖分类、跨模态对齐、神经生理推理
经信号必要性检验与专家核验
评估了11个开源与闭源VLM
reason: 新的EEG-VLM基准，专家核验，但规模较小，预印本
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.

title: Segment Anything for Microscopy 2
zh_title: 显微镜分割基础模型 Segment Anything for Microscopy 2
summary: 将SAM2适配至光镜与电镜的2D/3D联合分割，训练于超2300万细胞与核标注，并支持分类与细胞追踪。
key_points: 训练数据含2300万+细胞与核、160万细胞结构
体数据上优于通用与专用方法
功能含分类与2D/3D细胞追踪
reason: 大规模生物影像基础模型，预印本，有基线对比
abstract: Foundation models have advanced microscopy image segmentation, but existing models are trained on two-dimensional data, struggle with complex structures in volumetric data, and address only a narrow range of analysis tasks. Here we present Segment Anything for Microscopy 2 (SAM2), a foundation model that adapts SAM2 to joint 2D and 3D segmentation in light and electron microscopy. Trained on annotations of more than 23 million cells and nuclei and 1.6 million cellular structures, SAM2 achieves state-of-the-art automatic and interactive segmentation and outperforms generalist and specialist methods on volumetric data. Dedicated models further enable accurate mitochondrion and nucleus segmentation in electron microscopy. Beyond segmentation, SAM2 supports pixel and object classification from few annotations as well as cell tracking in 2D and 3D time-lapse data. All functionality is available in the user-friendly SAM napari plugin. We demonstrated the capabilities of SAM2 on challenging use cases spanning developmental biology, organoid research, cardiac physiology, and histopathology.
zh_abstract: 基础模型推动了显微图像分割的发展，但现有模型是在二维数据上训练的，难以处理体数据中的复杂结构，且只能应对范围较窄的分析任务。在此，我们提出 Segment Anything for Microscopy 2（SAM2），这是一个将 SAM2 适配于光学显微镜和电子显微镜中二维与三维联合分割的基础模型。SAM2 在超过 2300 万个细胞和细胞核以及 160 万个细胞结构的标注上训练，实现了最先进的自动和交互式分割，并在体数据上优于通用型和专用型方法。专用模型还可在电子显微镜中实现准确的线粒体和细胞核分割。除分割之外，SAM2 还支持基于少量标注的像素和对象分类，以及二维和三维延时数据中的细胞追踪。所有功能均可在用户友好的 SAM napari 插件中使用。我们在涵盖发育生物学、类器官研究、心脏生理学和组织病理学的具有挑战性的用例中展示了 SAM2 的能力。

abstract: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.

abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] Drug-drug interactions (DDIs) are a preventable cause of adverse drug events (ADEs), yet conventional interaction-checking tools are hampered by incomplete knowledge, poor concordance, and clinically unusable alert burdens. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly utilized to strengthen multiple stages of the DDI pathway. This narrative review synthesizes literature identified through searches conducted between 15 July and 20 October 2026. It examines how machine learning (ML) predicts novel drug interactions from molecular structure and knowledge graphs; how natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) identify and extract interactions from the literature, drug labels, and pharmacovigilance data; and how AI can make clinical decision support context-aware and support medication review. It also integrates mechanistic physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling and individualized patient-level risk prediction. Prediction models achieve impressive benchmark accuracy but frequently underperform in realistic, cold-start settings; LLMs detect interactions with high sensitivity but show poor severity calibration and persistent hallucination. The near-term value of AI lies less in autonomous prediction than in curating knowledge, personalizing alerts, and augmenting clinician judgment. Rigorous external validation, interpretability, and regulatory clarity are prerequisites for clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] 药物-药物相互作用（DDI）是药物不良事件（ADE）的一个可预防原因，但传统的相互作用检查工具受限于知识不完整、一致性差以及临床上难以接受的警报负担。人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于加强 DDI 路径的多个环节。本叙述性综述综合了在 2026 年 7 月 15 日至 10 月 20 日期间检索到的文献。它探讨了机器学习（ML）如何根据分子结构和知识图谱预测新的药物相互作用；自然语言处理（NLP）和大语言模型（LLM）如何从文献、药品说明书和药物警戒数据中识别并提取相互作用；以及 AI 如何使临床决策支持具备情境感知能力并支持用药审查。它还整合了机制性的生理药代动力学（PBPK）建模和个体化的患者层面风险预测。预测模型在基准测试中取得了令人印象深刻的准确性，但在现实的冷启动场景中往往表现不佳；LLM 检测相互作用的敏感性高，但严重程度校准较差，并持续存在幻觉。AI 的近期价值与其说在于自主预测，不如说在于整理知识、个性化警报以及增强临床医生的判断。严格的外部验证、可解释性和监管明确性是临床应用的前提条件。

abstract: AbstractClinical AI is being adopted faster than it is being evaluated, on the promise that it will improve health and reduce waste. Aran and colleagues show that large language models recommend more up-front testing, referrals, and treatment than the physicians who actually saw the patients and at more than three times cost, at least in the short-term. But practicing differently is not the same as practicing worse: whether this reflects wasteful excess or appropriate thoroughness is unknown, as are the consequences for long-run health and spending. On one hand, more up-front care could reduce diagnostic errors, catch disease earlier, deliver guideline-concordant treatment that clinicians overlook, and avert costly late-stage care. On the other hand, it could surface incidental findings that spark anxiety and follow-up cascades, add treatments of marginal benefit, and raise spending through added visits and more intensive billing and diagnosis coding. Neither vignettes nor single-visit studies can settle this. Clinical AI deserves the standard we would demand of any new therapy: trials that randomize practices to these tools and measure long-run effects on patients' health and spending.
zh_abstract: 摘要：临床人工智能（AI）的应用速度快于其评估速度，其依据是它有望改善健康并减少浪费。Aran 及其同事表明，大语言模型推荐的前期检查、转诊和治疗多于实际接诊患者的医生，且成本超过三倍，至少在短期内如此。但做法不同并不等于做法更差：这究竟反映的是浪费性的过度医疗还是恰当的周全，尚不清楚，其对长期健康和支出的影响同样未知。一方面，更多的前期医疗可能减少诊断错误、更早发现疾病、提供临床医生所忽视的符合指南的治疗，并避免代价高昂的晚期治疗。另一方面，它可能带来引发焦虑和后续连锁检查的偶然发现、增加获益甚微的治疗，并通过增加就诊次数以及更高强度的计费和诊断编码而推高支出。病例情景研究和单次就诊研究都无法解决这一问题。临床 AI 应当接受我们对任何新疗法所要求的标准：将诊疗机构随机分配使用这些工具，并衡量其对患者健康和支出的长期影响的试验。

summary: 提出序列无关的多栈脑MRI超分辨框架MS-HVED，融合轴、冠、矢状位栈，并在尼日利亚队列中进行专家读片评估（预印本）。

abstract: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved
zh_abstract: 高分辨率脑部MRI对神经放射学评估十分重要，但常规临床方案往往依赖快速的各向异性二维采集，在资源受限的环境中尤其如此。这些采集在方向、对齐和解剖覆盖范围上可能存在差异，从而产生部分重叠的图像堆栈。现有基于学习的超分辨率方法通常依赖单一的欠约束输入，或具有理想化采集几何结构的固定多堆栈配置。我们提出了MS-HVED，一种与序列无关、用于灵活多堆栈脑部MRI超分辨率的框架。可用的轴位、冠状位和矢状位堆栈被分别编码为多尺度高斯后验，并通过感知视野（field-of-view）的高斯乘积（Product-of-Gaussians）公式进行融合，以限制来自无支持区域的贡献。基于物理信息的域随机化模拟了异质的临床采集条件，包括倾斜、部分覆盖和成像伪影。MS-HVED在合成基准测试中取得了具有竞争力或更优的重建保真度，并相较于低分辨率输入改善了下游组织分割。为评估在训练队列之外的泛化能力，我们对来自尼日利亚队列的30例常规脑部MRI检查进行了外部临床验证，该队列代表了医学影像研究中代表性不足的人群。这些检查构成了一项盲法读片者研究中最大的部分，该研究涉及44例真实病例和7名神经放射学专家。在尼日利亚队列中，在210次配对评估中，有187次在整体图像质量上MS-HVED优于有监督基线。在所有临床队列中，使用全部可用输入时MS-HVED获得更高的整体质量评分（5.93 对 4.49，p<.001），当省略轴位或冠状位输入时这种偏好依然存在（p<.001）。代码见 github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents

abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.
zh_abstract: 既往研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）在招聘和智力评估等高关注度的一次性决策场景中表现出隐性偏见。然而，随着人们越来越多地使用由LLM驱动的自主AI智能体在日常任务中代为决策，我们必须了解基于社会人口学假设的隐性偏见如何在广泛的日常决策场景中出现。我们利用美国时间使用调查（ATUS）中的17个日常活动领域，生成了一份包含506个决策场景的图谱；在这些场景中，被赋予代表不同种族、性别认同和政治意识形态的人设（persona）的LLM表现出显著的隐性偏见。随后，在一项众包审计中，500名参与者就哪些存在隐性偏见的决策场景最值得进一步审查做出了8,010次二选一选择。我们发现，参与者优先关注具有广泛相关性的决策场景（如有关食物选择的场景）、高风险的决策场景（如有关健康的场景），以及模拟的某一社会人口学群体所有成员做出一致决策的场景（因为这清楚地表明存在刻板印象）。他们较少受到所观察到差异的大小或决策场景所代表的具体ATUS领域的影响。在考察其优先级选择背后的理由时，我们发现参与者常常把差异解释为人口学群体的特质，并判断这些特质是否看似合理，而这种判断往往基于他们自己内化的刻板印象。我们讨论了这些发现对构建个性化AI智能体、数字孪生、社会模拟以及使用众包偏见审计的意义。

abstract: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

abstract: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.

title: When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision
zh_title: 专家分歧何时有害：LLM 决策修订中的权威与选择性

abstract: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than a/(1-a) times as often as correct ones, where a is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. The expert label, a prestige cue, adds reversals for four of the five models, yet its effect on accuracy ranges from a 5.2-point loss to a 2.4-point gain, so reversal counts are a poor proxy for harm. With identical arguments from both sources, the label still raises reversal for three proprietary models and in a pooled analysis of four newer models. Models also respond to stated source reliability. Revision pipelines should therefore be evaluated with paired, conditional metrics, per model and protocol.
zh_abstract: 当语言模型在另一个智能体表示不同意后修改其决策时，无论是反转次数还是最终准确率，都无法说明它们是在纠正错误还是在放弃正确答案。我们提出一种受控的两轮审计方法，保持问题、证据和模型的初始答案不变，仅改变修订情境：中性反思、匿名异议，或归因于领域专家的异议。对于二元决策，其核算是精确的：只有当修订具有足够的选择性时，即推翻错误答案的频率超过推翻正确答案频率的 a/(1-a) 倍（其中 a 为初始准确率；准确率为 90% 时为9倍），修订才会提高准确率。在医学、科学和法律领域的五个模型和1,989个基于证据的决策中，没有任何模型在专家异议下达到这一标准，准确率最多下降16.1个百分点。专家标签作为一种声望线索，使五个模型中的四个反转增多，但其对准确率的影响从下降5.2个百分点到提高2.4个百分点不等，因此反转次数并不能很好地代表危害。当两种来源提供相同论据时，该标签仍会使三个专有模型以及四个较新模型的合并分析中的反转增加。模型也会对所陈述的来源可靠性作出反应。因此，修订流程应按模型和方案，采用配对的条件性指标进行评估。

title: Multiparametric 0.4-T low-field MRI mapping for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in rats.
zh_title: 大鼠MASLD的0.4T低场多参数MRI定量成像
summary: 前瞻性横断面临床前研究，在90只大鼠中用深度学习重建T1成像的0.4T多参数MRI评估MASLD，并以数字病理对照。
key_points: 90只Wistar大鼠，饮食诱导、进展与恢复
指标含T1、FcT1、T2、T2*及PDFF估计
以全切片数字病理量化脂肪、纤维化、炎症与铁
reason: 动物单研究、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [European radiology experimental] Low-field MRI may broaden access to quantitative liver imaging, but low signal-to-noise ratio and coexisting steatosis, inflammation, fibrosis, and iron complicate relaxometry in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We evaluated multiparametric 0.4-T MRI with deep-learning-reconstructed T1 mapping in rats. In this prospective cross-sectional preclinical study, 90 male Wistar rats underwent 0.4-T liver MRI during dietary induction, progression, and recovery. Metrics included native T1, fat-corrected T1 (FcT1), T2, T2*, and an apparent proton density fat fraction (PDFF) estimate. Whole-section digital pathology quantified steatosis, fibrosis, inflammation, and iron. Associations were assessed using iron-adjusted and stage-aware analyses, multivariable regression with variance inflation factors, and receiver operating characteristic analysis. Steatosis strongly correlated with T2 (ρ = 0.90, p 2.42% (0.77 versus 0.62; p = 0.008) and > 2.90% (0.78 versus 0.60; p = 0.001). Stage-aware analyses attenuated T1-fibrosis associations, and recovery animals showed residual fibrosis with near-baseline T1. Multiparametric 0.4-T MRI showed complementary, partly stage-dependent associations with MASLD pathology. T2/PDFF tracked steatosis; T2* retained an inflammation-related association after stage adjustment; and T1 elevation characterized active high-burden progression rather than isolated residual fibrosis. Human validation and platform calibration are required. Question Noninvasive MASLD assessment needs accessible imaging biomarkers that account for coexisting steatosis, inflammation, fibrosis, and iron-related confounding in liver MRI. Findings Multiparametric 0.4-T MRI showed complementary but stage-dependent associations: T2/apparent PDFF tracked steatosis, T2* related to inflammation, and T1 rose during high-burden progression. Relevance statement Multiparametric 0.4-T MRI provides complementary pathology-correlated measurements for MASLD assessment in rats, but reconstruction-dependent T1 bias and apparent PDFF estimation require platform calibration and human validation before clinical interpretation.
zh_abstract: [欧洲放射学实验] 低场MRI可能扩大定量肝脏成像的可及性，但信噪比低，以及并存的脂肪变性、炎症、纤维化和铁沉积，使代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的弛豫测量变得复杂。我们在大鼠中评估了采用深度学习重建T1成像的多参数0.4-T MRI。在这项前瞻性横断面临床前研究中，90只雄性Wistar大鼠在饮食诱导、进展及恢复过程中接受了0.4-T肝脏MRI。指标包括原生T1、脂肪校正T1（FcT1）、T2、T2*以及表观质子密度脂肪分数（PDFF）估计值。全切片数字病理定量了脂肪变性、纤维化、炎症和铁。采用经铁校正和分期感知的分析、带方差膨胀因子的多变量回归以及受试者工作特征分析评估相关性。脂肪变性与T2高度相关（ρ = 0.90，p 2.42%（0.77 对 0.62；p = 0.008）以及 > 2.90%（0.78 对 0.60；p = 0.001）。分期感知分析削弱了T1与纤维化的关联，恢复期动物表现为残余纤维化而T1接近基线。多参数0.4-T MRI显示出与MASLD病理互补的、部分依赖于分期的关联。T2/PDFF反映脂肪变性；T2*在分期校正后仍保留与炎症相关的关联；T1升高表征的是活动性的高负荷进展，而非孤立的残余纤维化。仍需进行人体验证和平台校准。问题：无创MASLD评估需要可及的影像生物标志物，以考虑肝脏MRI中并存的脂肪变性、炎症、纤维化及铁相关混杂。发现：多参数0.4-T MRI显示出互补但依赖分期的关联：T2/表观PDFF反映脂肪变性，T2*与炎症相关，T1在高负荷进展期升高。相关性说明：多参数0.4-T MRI为大鼠MASLD评估提供了与病理相关的互补测量，但依赖于重建的T1偏倚和表观PDFF估计，在临床解读之前需要平台校准和人体验证。

title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
zh_title: System 1 智能体：本地、可靠、快速的智能体方法
summary: 提出无需生成文本的本地 System 1 智能体，用确定性编译器将工具调用转为选择题，在157个生物医学工具的1952条请求上评测。
key_points: 在1952条请求中，工具选择或正确拒绝率为97.0%，高于18种本地LLM智能体设置（最佳95.2%）
6056个参数值中填充97.0%
System 1 调用中未出现编造内容
reason: 新方法有基线对比，但为预印本且为工具调用基准，非临床验证
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
zh_abstract: 智能体人工智能可以自动分析敏感的临床数据，但目前的智能体依赖大语言模型（LLM）。云端 LLM 会暴露患者数据。本地 LLM 会产生幻觉，而工具调用中虚构的数值会在之后的每一步中传播。在此我们提出一种构建 System 1 智能体的方法：这类本地智能体无需生成文本即可调用工具。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的模式（schema）和请求转换为多项选择题，其选项来自请求和模式，然后由单次前向的决策模型作答。在针对 157 个生物医学工具的 1,952 条请求中，最佳 System 1 智能体为 97.0% 的请求选对了工具或正确地拒绝调用，显著优于全部 18 种本地 LLM 智能体设置（最佳为 95.2%）。System 1 智能体填充了 6,056 个已陈述参数值中的 97.0%。System 1 的调用中没有出现虚构内容，而 LLM 调用中该比例为 5.5%–19.7%。System 1 Agents 框架作为开源软件免费提供，网址为 https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents。

title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
zh_title: PlainPairs：美国处方药标签医生版与患者版配对语料库
summary: 基于 openFDA 构建开放语料库，含 35,177 份带患者文本的处方药标签、250,829 个与医生版章节匹配的患者文本片段，并附阅读难度指标。
key_points: 另含 NCI 癌症信息摘要 756 份，中英文
提供阅读水平与通俗语言措辞统计
公开语料可用于医患文本简化研究
reason: 公开中等规模语料，有用但为单一作者预印本
abstract: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.
zh_abstract: 美国的处方药附有面向开处方者撰写的说明书，许多药品还附有面向患者的文本：用药指南（Medication Guide）或患者包装说明书。这两种文本为两类读者描述同一种药品，但公共资源很少将二者并列呈现。我提出 PlainPairs，这是一个基于 openFDA 药品标签文件构建的开放语料库。0.1.0 版包含35,177份带有患者文本的处方药标签、21,416份不同的患者文本、通过法规标题与开处方者章节匹配的250,829个患者文本片段、双方的阅读难度指标，以及基于规则的通俗语言措辞计数。第二个来源是美国国家癌症研究所的癌症信息摘要，新增756份摘要，包含医疗专业人员版和患者版，并有英文和西班牙文。按标签结构测量，用药指南的中位数阅读水平按 Flesch-Kincaid 为8.7年级，按 SMOG 为11.1年级。同样的指南若按批量文件提供的扁平化文本测量，阅读水平高出约两个年级，这一差异源于列表和标题边界的丢失。患者文本每100个句子中有41句直接称呼读者，而开处方者章节中为0.2句。对100对文本的盲法人工核查支持十种标题类型中七种的基于标题的对齐。该语料库、其代码和文档均已公开，发布版本将带有公司版权标记的文本排除在文本表之外。

title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
zh_title: FM-Recon：利用基础模型特征加速心脏电影MRI重建
summary: 提出将冻结的基础模型图像编码器特征融入展开式重建网络，在CMRxRecon2023数据集上评估，报告重建性能提升。
key_points: 冻结基础模型编码器特征嵌入展开网络
在伪影污染输入下仍能提取有效表征
基于CMRxRecon2023数据集系统评估
reason: 新颖预印本方法有基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.
zh_abstract: 基础模型（foundation models）已在多种医学影像任务中展现出强大的特征提取能力，但其在MRI重建中的潜力仍很大程度上未被探索，尤其是在展开式（unrolled）重建网络以及伪影污染输入的情形下。在本研究中，我们探讨预训练基础模型的特征是否以及如何有助于加速心脏电影MRI重建。为此，我们提出FM-Recon框架，该框架对基础模型冻结图像编码器所提取的特征进行优化，并将其整合到展开式重建网络中。通过在CMRxRecon2023数据集上开展的大量实验，我们在不同重建设置下系统评估了基础模型特征。结果表明，基础模型能够从伪影污染的输入中提取有信息量的表征并提升重建性能，在中等加速倍数下尤为明显。这些发现证明了基础模型特征用于加速MRI重建的潜力，并为将其有效整合进展开式重建网络提供了见解。

title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
zh_title: 声音重要吗？已部署临床语音智能体通话中的挫败感检测评估
summary: 在真实部署的临床语音智能体通话上评估逐轮挫败感检测，比较仅转录文本与音频模型，并以表演语料作对照。
key_points: 标注 6 通通话 150 轮，另有 30 通 714 轮
真实患者发言多很短，约 59% 为一两个词
单词轮次上仅转录检测不能排除随机水平
reason: 真实部署数据有新意，但样本小、预印本
abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.
zh_abstract: 自主语音智能体目前已可开展常规临床随访电话，因此一定程度的自动分诊不可避免。患者出现沮丧情绪就是分诊应当识别的情形之一。这类系统通常只读取语音转文字环节生成的转录文本，而不读取语音本身，而这是否足够，在真实临床语音上基本未经检验。我们研究了来自已部署临床语音智能体的真实患者通话中的逐轮沮丧检测：来自6次通话的150个轮次由三名标注者标注，并以长度匹配的表演语料库作为对照，另有来自30次通话的714个轮次。患者的发言轮次绝大多数很短：在已部署的通话中，约59%为一到两个词，而完整表演语料库中这一比例为13%；即使将表演语料按长度匹配后，语料库间的准确率差距依然存在。对于单词轮次，仅基于转录文本的检测无法排除随机水平。在五个具备音频能力的语言模型中，转录文本在30次通话的39个沮丧的单词轮次中只标出3或4个，而仅给定词数的分类器可达到57.3%。音频是否有帮助取决于模型和指令。当被要求关注说话方式时，两个Gemini 2.5模型在30次通话中比转录文本提高3.0个百分点（-1.0至7.5个百分点）。在它们有把握地判定为无沮丧的轮次中，使用音频时实际沮丧的占6.9%，而使用转录文本时为13.0%，差异为6.1个百分点（2.2至10.4个百分点）。在30次通话中，当对两种输入使用同一个提示时，没有任何模型的音频-文本区间排除零。在针对各输入专门设计的提示下，一个较新的Gemini模型和两个较小的开源模型使用音频时表现比使用转录文本更差（分别为-3.5、-8.6和-10.6个百分点）。基于临床通话训练的WavLM探针总体上与表现最佳的提示模型相当（71.6%），但在新增的24次通话中漏掉了每一个沮丧的单词轮次。当患者的发言很短时，仅凭转录文本不足以排除沮丧情绪。

title: Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences
zh_title: 一次涂鸦分割整个序列：超声心动图弱监督分割
summary: 提出基于冻结2D视觉基础模型、仅需单次涂鸦标注的双向时序一致性弱监督超声心动图序列分割框架。
key_points: 仅需序列中单次涂鸦标注
利用冻结2D视觉基础模型的空间先验
双向时序一致性传播信息
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，涉及基础模型，证据有限
abstract: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 时序医学图像分割依赖逐像素标注，而对于长图像序列而言，这种标注的成本高得令人难以承受。现有的弱监督方法虽然降低了每帧的标注负担，但仍需在整个序列中重复标注。此外，稀疏监督可能导致时间上不稳定的表征。要同时应对这两方面的挑战，需要一种既能利用大规模预训练带来的强空间先验、又能尽量减少对密集标注依赖的模型。冻结的二维视觉基础模型以较少的可训练参数提供可迁移的空间表征，为此提供了有前景的基础。然而，它们缺乏显式的时间建模，限制了其在解剖序列间传播可靠信息的能力。为此，我们提出了一种弱监督框架，仅需单个涂鸦（scribble）标注帧即可进行时序分割，其余所有帧均不标注。该框架在均值教师（mean-teacher）架构中结合了对 DINOv3 编码器的参数高效适配。此外，一组互补的损失函数（包括时间损失）有助于为未标注帧生成可靠的分割先验。这一设计使标注成本与序列长度脱钩，同时保留了预训练编码器可迁移的空间知识。在公开的 CAMUS 和 CardiacNet 数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于其他涂鸦监督方法。这些结果表明，在极其稀疏的监督下也能实现准确且时间一致的分割，从而大幅降低时序超声心动图分割的标注需求，并为可扩展的临床部署提供了实用框架。

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
zh_title: MedJev：用于快速医学图像理解的系统一视觉语言决策模型
summary: MedJev去除自回归生成，单次前向将图像、问题和候选答案直接映射为决策，以降低推理延迟和解析错误。

保留完整视觉通路与全部视觉token
决策头对候选答案打分并精炼

abstract: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

summary: 在配对的英语-豪萨语MedMCQA题上评估3–4B指令微调模型，发现豪萨语准确率显著下降，部分模型未超过多数类基线。
key_points: 多个模型未超过总选最常见选项的基线
所有差距经Holm校正均显著
回译可恢复约一半至三分之二差距
reason: 低资源语言公平性试点，预注册设计但模型小、规模有限
abstract: A system that reads nothing and always answers the most frequent letter scores \BaselineP{} on our Hausa medical multiple-choice set. \NBelowBaseline{} of the \NModels{} small open models we evaluate do not beat it. We lead with that because the usual summary of a multilingual result -- a percentage-point drop from English -- does not say whether what survives the drop is performance at all. On a paired English--Hausa set of \NEval{} MedMCQA items, three instruction-tuned models of 3--4B parameters lose between \GapMedGemma{} and \GapQwen{} points of accuracy, every gap significant after Holm correction. Back-translating the Hausa items into English recovers between half and two-thirds of the gap for the two general-purpose models but not demonstrably for the medically adapted one, so the deficit is substantially, though not wholly, a matter of the language of presentation. Answers are also far less stable: agreement across three option orderings falls from \ConsEnQwen{} to \ConsHaQwen{} in the worst case. An exploratory error analysis of \ENRows{} discordant items attributes most of the damage to medical vocabulary lost in translation (\ETerm{}, 95\% CI \ETermLo{}--\ETermHi{}), usually in the question stem. A fourth registered hypothesis proposed closing the gap with self-generated preference pairs. Its pilot gate found nothing to train on: asked to reason in Hausa rather than to pick a letter, the model echoes the prompt back, switches into Swahili, or simply stops without answering; only \GateParse{} of chains are parseable. We report that intervention as not run, which is itself the sharper result -- a forced-choice benchmark cannot see a model that has no generative command of the language at all. All hypotheses, thresholds and decision rules were registered before any model was run, and all deviations are logged.

title: Savant: A Fast, Structure-Free Binding Affinity Predictor For Protein-Ligand Drug Screening
zh_title: Savant：无需结构的快速蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测器
summary: 提出仅用蛋白序列和配体线性文本表示估计解离常数的机器学习模型，旨在替代需 GPU 与较长时间的共折叠打分方法用于药物筛选。
key_points: 输入仅为氨基酸序列与配体文本表示
目标是快速、无需结构的亲和力预测
面向大规模候选分子筛选
reason: 药物发现方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比数据
abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity determines which of many candidate molecules is worth synthesizing and assaying, making it the central measurement in early drug discovery. Binding affinity is commonly expressed as the dissociation constant, an equilibrium measure that indicates how easily a complex separates into its components. AI-based generative chemistry and make-on-demand chemical catalogs now produce molecules faster than rigorous method can evaluate them. Leading computational methods co-fold the complex before scoring the binding affinity between the protein and the ligand, which provides high accuracy but requires a graphics processing unit (GPU) and substantial time for every pair evaluated.Here we present Savant, a machine learning model that estimates the dissociation constant using only the protein's amino acid sequence and the ligand's structure written as a line of text (SMILES). Savant needs no 3-dimensional folded structure, no docking, and no GPU. To test Savant fairly, we built a benchmark designed to prevent any training data to leak into the testing set, drawing only on measurements published after the training data was assembled and on molecules chemically unlike anything the model had seen. On an independent benchmark, Savant ranks ahead of every other 3-dimensional structure-free method.Savant is designed to rank compounds against a single protein, and performs as well as other methods that require a GPU, while running only on a central processing unit (CPU). Thus, Savant can screen libraries of 100,000 compounds in minutes with commodity hardware.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质-配体结合亲和力决定了众多候选分子中哪些值得合成和检测，因此是早期药物发现中的核心测量指标。结合亲和力通常以解离常数表示，这是一种平衡测量指标，反映复合物分解为各组分的难易程度。基于人工智能的生成化学和按需合成化学品目录产生分子的速度，如今已超过严谨方法能够评估的速度。领先的计算方法在对蛋白质与配体之间的结合亲和力评分之前，先对复合物进行共折叠（co-fold），这虽然精度高，但每评估一对分子都需要图形处理器（GPU）和大量时间。在此，我们提出 Savant，这是一种机器学习模型，仅利用蛋白质的氨基酸序列和以一行文本（SMILES）书写的配体结构来估计解离常数。Savant 不需要三维折叠结构，不需要对接，也不需要 GPU。为了公平地测试 Savant，我们构建了一个旨在防止任何训练数据泄漏到测试集的基准，仅使用训练数据汇集之后发表的测量结果，以及在化学上与模型所见过的任何分子均不相似的分子。在一个独立基准上，Savant 的排名领先于所有其他不依赖三维结构的方法。Savant 旨在针对单一蛋白质对化合物进行排序，其表现与其他需要 GPU 的方法相当，而仅在中央处理器（CPU）上运行。因此，Savant 可在普通硬件上于数分钟内筛选包含 100,000 个化合物的库。

title: Sequence-based models predict TF binding with negligible contributions from motif cooperativity
zh_title: 序列模型预测转录因子结合：基序协同作用贡献可忽略
summary: 利用约2000个ENCODE转录因子结合谱训练的BPNet模型评估基序协同性，发现其对全基因组结合预测贡献可忽略（预印本）。
key_points: 基于约2000个ENCODE TF谱的BPNet
个别位点可检出协同但全局贡献小
模型可区分基序相似TF的结合偏好
reason: 大规模数据的基础生物学分析，预印本，有新见解
abstract: How transcription factors (TFs) selectively recognize their genomic targets among numerous sites containing similar DNA motifs remains an open question. Cooperative binding at neighboring motif sites is widely considered a key mechanism of TF specificity, yet its genome-wide contribution remains unclear. Machine learning models can now predict TF binding directly from DNA sequence, providing opportunities to investigate its underlying determinants. Here, we leveraged BPNet models trained on ~2,000 ENCODE TF binding profiles to systematically assess motif cooperativity. Although detected at individual loci, cooperativity made a negligible contribution to genome-wide binding predictions. Nevertheless, the models captured differences in binding preferences between TFs with similar motif preferences, even within the same cellular environment. These findings highlight the need to critically assess prevailing assumptions and explore alternative mechanisms underlying selective TF binding.
zh_abstract: 转录因子（TF）如何在大量含有相似DNA基序的位点中选择性识别其基因组靶点，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在相邻基序位点上的协同结合被广泛认为是TF特异性的关键机制，但其在全基因组范围内的贡献仍不清楚。机器学习模型现在可以直接从DNA序列预测TF结合，为研究其潜在决定因素提供了机会。在此，我们利用基于约2,000个ENCODE TF结合谱训练的BPNet模型，系统评估了基序协同性。尽管在个别位点可检测到协同性，但其对全基因组结合预测的贡献可忽略不计。然而，即使在相同的细胞环境中，这些模型仍能捕捉到具有相似基序偏好的TF之间在结合偏好上的差异。这些发现凸显了有必要批判性地审视现有假设，并探索选择性TF结合背后的其他机制。

title: Uncertainty-aware longitudinal prediction of multiple adverse pregnancy outcomes
zh_title: 多种不良妊娠结局的不确定性感知纵向预测
summary: 基于nuMoM2b队列9289名初产妇的二次分析，用逻辑回归与Mondrian共形预测在多次产检中预测五类妊娠结局，评估既往预测是否增加信息（预印本）。
key_points: 多中心队列，9289名初产妇
共形预测输出低危/高危/需复核
检验历史预测是否增加信息
reason: 大样本多中心队列二次分析，方法较传统，预印本
abstract: Risk of pregnancy complications is reassessed at each antenatal visit, but whether earlier predictions add information beyond the most recent one is unclear. Classifying every prediction as low or high risk can leave uncertainty unexpressed. Whether reliability per visit holds across visits is also unclear. This secondary analysis included 9289 nulliparous women from the nuMoM2b cohort (eight US centres, 2010-2013). Logistic regression models predicted gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia, preterm birth, suspected fetal growth restriction and large for gestational age at 6-13, 16-21 and 22-29 weeks (Visits 3). Mondrian conformal prediction reported 'no' (low risk), 'yes' (high risk), or both (review). To test whether prediction history adds information beyond the Visit 3 prediction, we compared, among women classified as high risk at Visit 3, those first classified as high risk at Visit 2 or 3 (emerging high) with those classified as high risk at all three visits (persistent high), adjusting for Visit 3 predicted probability. The adjusted proportion with the outcome was higher in the emerging-high than the persistent-high group, by 6.1 percentage points for large for gestational age (95% CI -0.4 to 12.2) and 3.8 percentage points for suspected fetal growth restriction (-0.9 to 8.1). Other outcomes showed adjusted differences close to zero. With conformal prediction calibrated to a 90% level at each visit, the reported answers included the actual outcome in 89.6-90.6% of women at each visit (coverage). Coverage decreased when each woman's three visits were considered together (79.0-85.4%). For fetal growth outcomes, how a woman's predicted risk evolved during pregnancy may add information beyond her Visit 3 prediction. For repeated clinical use, the target coverage level should reflect the acceptable risk of incorrect low- or high-risk classifications over a woman's follow-up and the clinical decisions supported at each visit.
zh_abstract: 每次产前检查时都会重新评估妊娠并发症的风险，但较早的预测是否能在最近一次预测之外提供额外信息尚不清楚。将每次预测都分类为低风险或高风险可能使不确定性无法表达。各次检查之间每次检查的可靠性是否保持一致也不清楚。这项二次分析纳入了nuMoM2b队列（美国八个中心，2010-2013年）的9289名初产妇。逻辑回归模型分别在6-13周、16-21周和22-29周（访视3）预测妊娠期糖尿病、子痫前期、早产、疑似胎儿生长受限和大于胎龄儿。Mondrian保形预测给出“否”（低风险）、“是”（高风险）或两者皆有（需复核）。为检验预测历史是否能在访视3的预测之外增加信息，我们在访视3被分类为高风险的女性中，比较了在访视2或访视3首次被分类为高风险者（新近高风险）与在全部三次访视均被分类为高风险者（持续高风险），并对访视3的预测概率进行了校正。校正后出现结局的比例在新近高风险组高于持续高风险组，大于胎龄儿高6.1个百分点（95% CI -0.4至12.2），疑似胎儿生长受限高3.8个百分点（-0.9至8.1）。其他结局的校正后差异接近于零。在每次访视均按90%水平校准的保形预测下，所报告的答案在每次访视时包含实际结局的女性比例为89.6-90.6%（覆盖率）。当综合考虑每位女性的三次访视时，覆盖率下降（79.0-85.4%）。对于胎儿生长相关结局，女性预测风险在孕期中的演变过程可能在其访视3预测之外增加信息。对于重复性的临床使用，目标覆盖水平应反映在女性随访期间对错误的低风险或高风险分类的可接受风险，以及每次访视所支持的临床决策。

title: Casanovo-TMT: deep learning-based de novo sequencing of TMTpro-labeled peptides and phosphopeptides
zh_title: Casanovo-TMT：TMTpro标记肽及磷酸肽的深度学习从头测序
summary: 在Casanovo基础上扩展TMTpro与磷酸化词表，用2100万谱图微调，在自有与两个公开数据集上取得较高肽段识别率。

两个公开数据集为87.4%与79.6%

abstract: De novo peptide sequencing reads peptides directly from tandem mass spectra, but none of the released deep learning models can sequence peptides labeled with isobaric tags such as TMTpro, which are widely used for multiplexed quantitative proteomics. We extended the residue vocabulary of Casanovo with TMTpro tags and phosphorylation, fine-tuned it on 21 million spectra from our laboratory, most of them TMTpro-labeled, and re-ranked the candidates in the beam by their agreement with the measured precursor mass. The resulting model, Casanovo-TMT, predicted the exact peptidoform for 84.7% of the TMTpro-labeled spectra in our test set and for 87.4 and 79.6% of the spectra in two public global-proteome datasets from other laboratories, whereas the extended vocabulary without fine-tuning gave 0.3%. Discarding the lowest-scoring predictions raised precision to 95% while retaining 81.7% of the test spectra. Casanovo-TMT also predicted the exact peptidoform for 69.2% of the spectra in a public phosphopeptide-enriched dataset and for 66 to 72% of the phosphopeptide spectra in three phosphoproteomic studies from our laboratory that were not used for training. In these studies, it identified numbers of phosphopeptides comparable to or larger than those of database search engines, and proportionally more where database search identified fewer. For the phosphopeptides identified only by Casanovo-TMT, entrapment estimated that more than 90% were correct, and an independent search engine assigned the same sequence to 95 to 98% of the spectra that it identified with confidence. Casanovo-TMT can therefore extend database search in TMTpro-based quantitative proteomics, particularly in studies in which database search identifies few phosphopeptides.
zh_abstract: 从头肽段测序可直接从串联质谱中读取肽段序列，但目前已发布的深度学习模型均无法对用等重标签（如TMTpro）标记的肽段进行测序，而TMTpro广泛用于多重定量蛋白质组学。我们在Casanovo的残基词表中加入了TMTpro标签和磷酸化修饰，使用来自本实验室的2,100万张谱图（其中大部分为TMTpro标记）对其进行微调，并根据候选结果与实测前体质量的一致程度对束搜索（beam）中的候选结果重新排序。由此得到的模型Casanovo-TMT在我们测试集中对84.7%的TMTpro标记谱图预测出了准确的肽型（peptidoform），在来自其他实验室的两个公开全蛋白质组数据集中分别为87.4%和79.6%，而仅扩展词表而不微调时仅为0.3%。剔除得分最低的预测结果后，精确度提高到95%，同时保留了81.7%的测试谱图。Casanovo-TMT还对一个公开的磷酸肽富集数据集中69.2%的谱图预测出了准确的肽型，并对本实验室三项未用于训练的磷酸化蛋白质组学研究中66%至72%的磷酸肽谱图预测出了准确的肽型。在这些研究中，它鉴定到的磷酸肽数量与数据库搜索引擎相当或更多，且在数据库搜索鉴定较少的情况下，所占比例相对更高。对于仅由Casanovo-TMT鉴定到的磷酸肽，诱捕（entrapment）分析估计超过90%是正确的；对于其有把握鉴定的谱图，独立搜索引擎对其中95%至98%给出了相同的序列。因此，Casanovo-TMT可扩展基于TMTpro的定量蛋白质组学中的数据库搜索，尤其适用于数据库搜索鉴定到磷酸肽较少的研究。

title: DynSurvX: Time-Resolved Explanations for Dynamic Survival Predictions
zh_title: DynSurvX：动态生存预测的时间分辨解释
summary: 提出基于 Shapley 值的模型无关解释框架，为含静态与纵向协变量的动态生存预测提供随时间演变的解释。

abstract: Recent survival models integrating longitudinal data achieve strong predictive performance, but their predictions are often difficult to interpret, limiting their clinical use. We propose DynSurvX, a model-agnostic explainability framework for dynamic survival prediction with mixed static and longitudinal covariates. Based on Shapley values, DynSurvX introduces a hierarchical two-phase strategy that first identifies influential longitudinal features and then adaptively refines their temporal importance, enabling fine-grained explanations while reducing computational cost. The framework provides time-resolved explanations that evolve as new patient data become available. Experiments on simulated and two clinical datasets show varying agreement with theoretical importance across prediction models, with closer agreement for better-performing models, alongside clinically interpretable insights in real-world settings. It remains robust across prediction settings and reduces computation time by 41--80\% relative to the temporal explanation baseline, making dynamic explanations practical.

All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.

abstract: Generative data augmentation adds samples from generative models to a classifier's training set. Many influential studies use generators pre-trained on large external datasets, and so mix the value of synthetic data with knowledge transferred through pretraining. We study the case without external data, where each generator learns only from the classifier's own training set, and ask when and why adding generated samples to that training set raises or lowers the classifier's test accuracy. We train classifiers with four backbones on six datasets, two of them medical, adding samples from four generators. We bound the excess risk of a classifier trained with synthetic data, that is, how far its population risk can lie above the minimum risk within its hypothesis class. The bound charges synthetic data for the total variation distance between the real and generated distributions and credits synthetic data for a larger training set. The gain from adding synthetic data, the fall in population risk, is at most the excess risk of the real-only classifier, which trains on the real images alone. Read through the bound, the experiments suggest that synthetic data help most when our classifiers detect only a small discrepancy between the generated and real data and the real-only classifier has room to improve, and that synthetic data help little or hurt when the detected discrepancy is large. Generators with a larger lower bound on the total variation distance, a bound that we estimate from our own classifiers, tend to help less on five of the six datasets, and on the CIFAR datasets the most accurate backbone gains the least. The bound gives these directions but not the size of the largest gains, most of which traditional augmentation also reaches at the same number of optimizer steps.
