abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a leading cause of global morbidity and mortality despite major advances in pharmacological therapy, interventional cardiology, and lifestyle-based prevention. Although many current treatments reduce disease burden and improve outcomes, they often fail to address the underlying molecular and genetic mechanisms driving disease progression dot CRISPR hyphen-based gene- editing systems (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats) have introduced the possibility of directly correcting, silencing, or modulating pathogenic genetic determinants involved in cardiovascular pathology. When integrated with artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled design, prediction, and optimization tools, an AI-guided CRISPR framework may assist in prioritizing editing strategies, predicting editing outcomes, and informing delivery design, although cardiovascular-specific validation of these applications remains limited. This narrative review examines the potential role of AI-guided CRISPR technologies in cardiovascular disease. It first outlines the major pathophysiologic mechanisms underlying CVD, then reviews molecular and genetic targets that may be amenable to editing. Current CRISPR applications in cardiometabolic and cardiovascular disorders are discussed, followed by an evaluation of how AI may support guide RNA design, off-target prediction, vector engineering, and therapeutic prioritization. Finally, major translational barriers are examined, including tissue-specific delivery, editing in non-dividing cells, long-term genomic safety, disease complexity, and regulatory implementation. Although early preclinical findings are encouraging, most cardiovascular applications remain in the experimental or early translational stage, and direct evidence for integrated AI-guided CRISPR applications in cardiovascular disease remains limited and largely preclinical. Progress in this field will depend on advances in delivery science, genome engineering, computational modelling, and long-term safety validation. AI-guided CRISPR should therefore be regarded as a developing precision medicine strategy with substantial future potential rather than an immediately deployable clinical solution.
zh_abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] 尽管药物治疗、介入心脏病学和基于生活方式的预防取得了重大进展，心血管疾病（CVD）仍是全球发病和死亡的主要原因。虽然目前许多治疗可减轻疾病负担并改善结局，但往往无法针对驱动疾病进展的潜在分子和遗传机制。基于 CRISPR（成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列）的基因编辑系统使直接纠正、沉默或调控参与心血管病理的致病遗传决定因素成为可能。当与人工智能（AI）支持的设计、预测和优化工具相结合时，AI 引导的 CRISPR 框架可能有助于确定编辑策略的优先次序、预测编辑结果并为递送设计提供依据，不过这些应用在心血管领域的专门验证仍然有限。本叙述性综述探讨了 AI 引导的 CRISPR 技术在心血管疾病中的潜在作用。文章首先概述 CVD 的主要病理生理机制，然后回顾可能适合编辑的分子和遗传靶点。接着讨论 CRISPR 在心脏代谢及心血管疾病中的现有应用，并评估 AI 如何支持向导 RNA 设计、脱靶预测、载体工程和治疗优先级排序。最后，探讨主要的转化障碍，包括组织特异性递送、非分裂细胞中的编辑、长期基因组安全性、疾病复杂性以及监管实施。尽管早期临床前研究结果令人鼓舞，但大多数心血管应用仍处于实验或早期转化阶段，关于整合 AI 引导的 CRISPR 在心血管疾病中应用的直接证据仍然有限，且主要为临床前研究。该领域的进展将取决于递送科学、基因组工程、计算建模和长期安全性验证方面的进步。因此，AI 引导的 CRISPR 应被视为一种具有巨大未来潜力的、正在发展的精准医学策略，而非可立即部署的临床解决方案。

abstract: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.
zh_abstract: 跨域少样本分割旨在利用少量带像素标注的支持集掩码，将在自然图像上预训练的编码器适配到医学或工业领域。在冻结的 DINOv3 中，中间层各注意力头的消息（per-head attention messages）已经携带了目标与背景之间的区分信息，而基线方法的最终层相似度和预测并不能一致地反映这些信息。我们提出状态-消息交互适配器（State-Message Interaction Adapter，SMIA），在保持预训练注意力和 FFN 参数冻结的前提下，学习各头的消息应如何更新每个接收 token 的表示。SMIA 插入在各头聚合之后，将每个头的聚合输出（消息）的变换条件化于每个图像块的注意力前特征（状态），使得相似的上下文消息可以根据接收位置的不同产生不同甚至相反的更新。由于稀缺的支持集掩码仅覆盖有限的状态-消息组合，我们采用共享的低秩双线性映射，将所学习的交互限制在低维的状态、消息和输出子空间内。这些更新被加入每个被适配模块的冻结 FFN 之前，得到的适配后特征再由冻结的 FFN 和更深的模块进一步精炼，用于线性读出。SMIA 仅有 0.51M 可训练参数，推理时单次前向且无需支持集；在 20 个医学和工业任务的六个数据集上，其 5-shot 和 10-shot 的平均 mIoU 分别达到 77.40% 和 80.99%，较此前最强方法分别高出 3.61 和 3.93 个百分点。在同一 DINOv3 骨干网络上、跨三个基准的受控 10-shot 比较中，SMIA 也优于参数量相当的 AdaptFormer、LoRA 和 ParaX，并具有更好的精确率-召回率平衡。

title: Machine Learning Prediction of Antibiotic Resistance Genes: Performance, Interpretability, and Cross-Database Redundancy

summary: 以XGBoost基于氨基酸三联体频率和理化特征在CARD上分类耐药基因，AUROC 0.982，并用SHAP解释，探讨跨数据库冗余。

abstract: Antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) classifiers are typically developed and evaluated within a single curated database, leaving open how much two independently curated databases agree and what that implies for apparent cross-database generalization. We trained an XGBoost classifier on amino acid trigram frequencies and physicochemical descriptors using the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD), the field's largest curated ARG resource. The model separated resistance genes from non-resistance proteins with near-ceiling accuracy (AUROC = 0.982, MCC = 0.886); a label-shuffling null baseline collapsed to chance (AUROC = 0.508) and bootstrap confidence intervals were narrow, confirming genuine signal rather than data leakage or overfitting. SHAP analysis attributed this performance to biologically interpretable features, notably the trigram KTG, isoelectric point, and aromaticity, each consistent with known catalytic motifs in resistance enzymes. Before testing the classifier against ResFinder, one of CARD's most widely used counterparts, we assessed database independence by clustering sequences with CD-HIT, finding that 96.8-98.7% of ResFinder sequences shared substantial protein identity with CARD even at a permissive 50% identity threshold, indicating the two databases largely represent the same sequence population, with direct implications for how cross-database generalization should be measured. On the small subset of ResFinder sequences genuinely non-redundant with CARD (40-100 sequences, depending on threshold), the classifier failed completely, never classifying any as resistance genes; SHAP traced this failure to sequence length, as non-redundant sequences are nearly three times longer than training proteins, and length is among the model's most influential features. The same pattern emerged by resistance mechanism: the model achieved perfect accuracy on beta-lactamases, compact single-domain enzymes well represented in training (100%, n = 351), but correctly identified only 38.5% of efflux pump components (n = 13), a mechanism built from large, multi-domain transporters rather than compact catalytic enzymes. Together, these results describe a capable, interpretable ARG classifier alongside a quantified methodological caution: cross-database redundancy must be measured rather than assumed, and when a sequence-composition classifier fails, the failure is often explained by protein architecture rather than database origin.
zh_abstract: 抗生素耐药基因（ARG）分类器通常在单一的人工整理数据库内开发和评估，因此两个独立整理的数据库之间一致程度如何，以及这对表观的跨数据库泛化意味着什么，仍悬而未决。我们使用该领域最大的人工整理ARG资源——综合抗生素耐药性数据库（CARD），基于氨基酸三联体频率和理化描述符训练了XGBoost分类器。该模型以接近上限的准确度区分耐药基因与非耐药蛋白（AUROC = 0.982，MCC = 0.886）；标签打乱的零模型基线降至随机水平（AUROC = 0.508），自助法（bootstrap）置信区间较窄，证实其反映的是真实信号，而非数据泄漏或过拟合。SHAP分析将这一性能归因于具有生物学可解释性的特征，尤其是三联体KTG、等电点和芳香性，均与耐药酶中已知的催化基序一致。在用ResFinder（CARD最广泛使用的同类数据库之一）检验该分类器之前，我们通过CD-HIT对序列聚类来评估数据库的独立性，发现即使在宽松的50%同一性阈值下，仍有96.8–98.7%的ResFinder序列与CARD具有显著的蛋白同一性，表明两个数据库在很大程度上代表相同的序列群体，这对于应如何衡量跨数据库泛化具有直接意义。在ResFinder中与CARD真正非冗余的少量序列子集上（取决于阈值，为40–100条序列），分类器完全失败，没有将任何序列判为耐药基因；SHAP将这一失败追溯到序列长度：非冗余序列的长度几乎是训练蛋白的三倍，而长度是模型最具影响力的特征之一。按耐药机制分析也出现了相同模式：模型对β-内酰胺酶（训练中代表性充分的紧凑单结构域酶）达到完美准确率（100%，n = 351），但对外排泵组分仅正确识别38.5%（n = 13），外排泵由大型多结构域转运蛋白而非紧凑的催化酶构成。总之，这些结果既呈现了一个能力良好且可解释的ARG分类器，也给出了量化的方法学警示：跨数据库冗余必须加以测量而非想当然，而当序列组成分类器失败时，其原因往往在于蛋白质结构架构，而非数据库来源。

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Sarcopenia is a progressive skeletal muscle disorder associated with adverse health outcomes, including disability, hospitalization, and mortality. Despite the availability of consensus-based diagnostic criteria, its identification in clinical practice remains limited due to reliance on specialized assessments and resource-intensive measurements. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) approaches have emerged as promising tools to enhance sarcopenia detection; however, evidence remains methodologically heterogeneous and has not been comprehensively synthesized. The objective was to systematically map the existing literature on AI/ML models developed to detect or predict sarcopenia, describing their methodological characteristics, input features, model performance, validation strategies, and adherence to reporting standards. Methods: A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Searches were performed in five databases (MEDLINE, Scopus, SciELO, Web of Science, and LILACS) from inception to 28 February 2026. Studies were included if they developed and/or validated AI/ML models for binary classification of sarcopenia using recognized consensus definitions. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed adherence to TRIPOD+AI reporting recommendations and appraised methodological quality using the NHLBI Quality Assessment Tool. Findings were synthesized descriptively. The review protocol was registered in the Open Science Framework. Results: Of 2910 records, 28 studies (n = 34,498 participants in the primary analytical cohorts, with an additional 2800 participants in independent external validation cohorts) were included, predominantly from Asia (China n = 14, South Korea n = 7). Random Forest was the most frequent algorithm (n = 6), followed by voting classifiers, MLP, and XGBoost (n = 4 each). Clinical tabular data, including anthropometric and laboratory variables, were the most common input features. Model performance was generally high, with AUC values ranging from 0.710 to 0.975 (mean ≈ 0.869), although heterogeneity across populations and validation strategies was substantial. External validation was performed in only 7 of the 28 studies (25%). No study fully adhered to TRIPOD+AI recommendations; mean compliance was moderate, with critical gaps in code sharing, patient/public involvement, external validation, and subgroup performance reporting. Conclusions: AI/ML models

【方法】按照PRISMA-ScR指南开展范围综述。检索了五个数据库（MEDLINE、Scopus、SciELO、Web of Science和LILACS），检索时间从建库至2026年2月28日。纳入使用公认共识定义、开发和/或验证用于肌少症二分类的AI/ML模型的研究。两名评审员独立筛选研究、提取数据，评估其对TRIPOD+AI报告建议的遵循情况，并使用NHLBI质量评估工具评价方法学质量。研究结果采用描述性方式综合。综述方案已在Open Science Framework注册。
【结果】在2910条记录中，共纳入28项研究（主要分析队列n = 34,498名参与者，另有2800名参与者来自独立外部验证队列），主要来自亚洲（中国n = 14，韩国n = 7）。随机森林是最常用的算法（n = 6），其次是投票分类器、MLP和XGBoost（各n = 4）。包括人体测量和实验室变量在内的临床表格数据是最常见的输入特征。模型性能总体较高，AUC值范围为0.710至0.975（均值约0.869），但不同人群和验证策略之间的异质性较大。28项研究中仅7项（25%）进行了外部验证。没有研究完全遵循TRIPOD+AI建议；平均依从程度为中等，在代码共享、患者/公众参与、外部验证和亚组性能报告方面存在关键缺失。

abstract: [Heart failure clinics] This article examines the evolving role of artificial intelligence (AI) across the continuum of care in cardiomyopathies, from opportunistic screening to decision-critical risk stratification. AI-enhanced electrocardiography enables scalable early detection, while advanced echocardiographic and cardiac magnetic resonance-based radiomics refine myocardial substrate characterization. Multimodal models integrating imaging, electrical, and clinical data refine risk stratification beyond conventional metrics such as left ventricular ejection fraction. However, clinical translation requires external validation, calibration stability, interpretability, and structured workflow integration. AI emerges not as autonomous diagnosis, but as accountable, clinician-supervised decision support embedded within multidisciplinary cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: [心力衰竭门诊] 本文探讨人工智能（AI）在心肌病全程诊疗中不断演变的作用，涵盖从机会性筛查到决策关键的风险分层。AI增强的心电图可实现可扩展的早期检测，而先进的超声心动图及基于心脏磁共振的影像组学可进一步刻画心肌基质特征。整合影像、电学及临床数据的多模态模型，可在左心室射血分数等传统指标之外进一步优化风险分层。然而，临床转化需要外部验证、校准稳定性、可解释性以及结构化的工作流程整合。AI并非作为自主诊断工具出现，而是作为可问责的、由临床医生监督的决策支持，嵌入多学科心血管诊疗之中。

abstract: [Advances in medical education and practice] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical practice and medical education, yet research on AI and medical professional identity has largely evolved in parallel. To examine how AI is transforming fundamental components of medical professional identity and propose a framework for understanding its implications for professional identity formation in medical education. This narrative review synthesizes conceptual, empirical, and theoretical literature on AI, professional identity formation, and clinical practice through iterative literature searching and citation tracking. Peer-reviewed studies, regulatory data, and national survey reports were considered. AI affects professional identity unevenly. Diagnostic, predictive, generative, and emerging autonomous systems most directly influence expertise, clinical reasoning, and professional autonomy, shifting physicians from exclusive holders of specialized knowledge toward validators of increasingly accessible but variably trusted information. Evidence of automation bias and reduced diagnostic performance highlights this transition. We conceptualize the divergence between the formal locus of clinical responsibility, which remains with physicians, and the functional locus of influence decisions, shared with AI, as the formal-functional gap (FFG). Its magnitude varies by AI configuration, identity component, and career stage, potentially placing trainees at risk of never-skilling and experienced physicians at risk of deskilling. Ethical responsibility, humanistic care, lifelong learning, and professional authority are affected more indirectly. AI-mediated professional identity change reflects a dynamic interaction between physicians' developmental trajectories and evolving AI capabilities. Medical education should prioritize sustained expertise, clinical reasoning, professional autonomy, AI-interpretive judgment, and human oversight. The FFG remains a conceptual framework whose relationships require empirical validation.
zh_abstract:
【背景】[医学教育与实践进展] 人工智能（AI）日益融入临床实践和医学教育，但有关AI与医学职业身份的研究在很大程度上是各自平行发展的。
【目的】探讨AI如何改变医学职业身份的基本组成部分，并提出一个框架，用于理解其对医学教育中职业身份形成的影响。
【方法】本叙述性综述通过迭代式文献检索和引文追踪，综合了关于AI、职业身份形成和临床实践的概念性、实证性和理论性文献。纳入了同行评审研究、监管数据和全国性调查报告。
【结果】AI对职业身份的影响并不均衡。诊断型、预测型、生成型以及新兴的自主系统最直接地影响专业知识、临床推理和职业自主性，使医生从专业知识的唯一持有者转变为对日益易得但可信度不一的信息进行验证的人。自动化偏倚和诊断表现下降的证据凸显了这一转变。我们将临床责任的正式归属（仍由医生承担）与决策影响的功能性归属（与AI共享）之间的分歧概念化为“正式-功能差距”（formal-functional gap，FFG）。其大小因AI配置、身份组成部分和职业阶段而异，可能使受训者面临“从未获得技能”（never-skilling）的风险，使经验丰富的医生面临技能退化（deskilling）的风险。伦理责任、人文关怀、终身学习和职业权威受到的影响则较为间接。AI介导的职业身份变化反映了医生发展轨迹与不断演进的AI能力之间的动态相互作用。
【结论】医学教育应优先重视持续的专业知识、临床推理、职业自主性、对AI的解读判断能力以及人的监督。FFG仍是一个概念框架，其相互关系有待实证验证。
